cutoverSequence: After separate infrastructure/database approval, confirm the existing database-owner execution path, snapshot and frozen source hashes
Hold indexer at desired count zero before transaction 1; await its task stopping and record the final committed processor checkpoint
Submit approved deployments/configuration/permission steps 1-12; keep new NPCs paused and verify all receipts and the actual deployment block
Recheck migration ledger and empty legacy-request table, stop legacy breeding writers, and apply the owner SQL transaction with ON_ERROR_STOP

Publish the frozen backend images only after approval; update indexer with actual deployment block and resume from its unchanged global checkpoint
Verify catch-up, registry events, API reads and unchanged ownership/XP/size; do not import until these checks pass

requirements: Never reset or advance the existing global transfer cursor manually

Existing squid login cannot apply metadata DDL; use the reviewed owner transaction and its narrow runtime grants
Preserve existing XP, dates and size percentages; never reimport or reroll existing Evos
recovery: If the owner transaction fails, roll it back and leave the new NPCs paused; do not start the new indexer with pending migrations
After nursery events exist, do not resume an older indexer that ignores them; preserve the saved checkpoint and registry for forward recovery
Pause new NPCs and disable private signing on failure. Keep pending requests and genuine callbacks recoverable; do not drop registry data or roll back minting
